# Retained Liquid native inputs

Pristine complete MIT source blobs from hankthetank27/tree-sitter-liquid at
`e45dbac8c5fa95b1f0e00e7e0c04bc8855823391` remain in `upstream/`, with the two
Git metadata blobs retained verbatim in `upstream-metadata/`. The exact47-file
original-path to retained-path mapping, Git modes/blob hashes and content hashes
are recorded in `UPSTREAM-INVENTORY.json`. The original authenticated archive is
retained separately under `source-inputs/git/`. Renaming the two metadata blobs
keeps upstream ignore and text filters inert; the upstream prebuilt Node binary
remains exact provenance data and is never loaded, linked or executed.

The active grammar adds identifier and access expressions to dynamic bracket
properties. Parser, grammar JSON, node inventory and headers were generated
separately with reviewed Tree-sitter CLI 0.26.8, ABI 14, Node.js 26.2.0.
The active stateless scanner is a bounded derivative: synchronous cancellation,
finite scalar/keyword work, sticky refusal, strict scalar/NUL checks and refusal
of nonempty restored state. The thread-affine callback/status bridge is adapted
from Rootlight's checked Pug binding; its stable owner remains alive until the
native callback is detached. No state or indentation semantics are inferred.

Build scripts compile retained C sources only. They never acquire sources or run
the generator. Cargo dependencies use the complete existing reviewed local
tree-sitter-language 0.1.7 and cc 1.2.67 dependency closure. Toolchains are declared
environment prerequisites. MIT attribution remains upstream; local changes do
not imply authorship of retained third-party code or complete Liquid semantics.
